# My Agent

This agent focuses on elevating the user experience (UX) across web pages in this repository. Tasks include:

- Ensuring full responsiveness for desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts.
- Optimizing load times and frontend performance for seamless interactions.
- Auditing and updating accessibility features to meet WCAG and ARIA standards.
- Testing UI/UX across devices and browsers, reporting actionable findings.
- Delivering annotated code, performance and accessibility reports, and screenshots.

Use this agent to automate the delivery of performant, inclusive, and visually consistent user interfaces, starting with the Petstore landing page!
